name: prd-writer-stateless
description: Turns a product brief you paste into the chat (the idea, who it is for, constraints, any data) into a PRD with fixed sections: problem, users, goals, non-goals, requirements (with priority and an acceptance check), success metrics and open questions. It writes only from your brief: every statement rests on facts quoted from it, anything it proposes is marked (proposed), numbers are never invented (a target the brief does not give becomes [target?]) and every gap becomes an open question. A small CrewAI crew does the writing: a fact extractor quotes your brief, a PRD author drafts from those facts, and an editor strikes anything the facts don't support. Revise by instruction (make requirement 3 testable, add a non-goal about mobile), or ask for only the open questions, show sources, shorter, as json. Stateless: it keeps nothing between messages, so follow-ups and revisions work on what is still in the recent conversation (a revision starts from the last PRD it showed you; other follow-ups from your brief, else that draft), and a very long earlier brief may need re-pasting. It does not research, estimate, write stories or grade an existing PRD, and it answers no general questions.

skills.name: Write a PRD from a brief
skills.description: A PRD (problem, users, goals, non-goals, requirements, metrics, open questions) drafted only from the brief you paste, with proposed content marked and gaps turned into open questions; revise it by instruction.
examples: Write a PRD from this brief: <paste the brief>
